preconditions.expression: all(32 <= ord(char) <= 127 for char in stdin if char != '\n')
preconditions.description: All characters in the input lines have codes from 32 to 127 (inclusive), except for newlines.
The size of the input does not exceed 1048576 bytes.
The input ends with a newline.
The input contains at least one character other than a newline.

postconditions.expression: all(32 <= ord(char) <= 127 for char in stdout if char != '\n')
postconditions.description: All characters in the output lines have codes from 32 to 127 (inclusive), except for newlines.
The output ends with a newline.

postconditions.expression: all(line.startswith('#') or ' ' not in line for line in stdout.split('\n') if line)
postconditions.description: Spaces are removed from all non-amplifying lines.

postconditions.expression: all((lines[i].startswith('#') or lines[i+1].startswith('#')) or lines[i] + lines[i+1] in stdout for i in range(len(lines)-1) if not lines[i].startswith('#') and not lines[i+1].startswith('#'))
all((lines[i-1].startswith('#') and lines[i+1].startswith('#')) or lines[i] in stdout for i in range(1, len(lines)-1) if lines[i] == '')
postconditions.description: Empty lines are preserved if surrounded by amplifying lines.
